description:
MARS: SURVIVAL
Un juego de Roblox para aprender cómo se sobrevive en Marte.

¿De qué trata?
Desarrollamos en Roblox Studio un juego de supervivencia y administración de recursos ambientado en Marte, pensado para niños de 7 a 12 años. El jugador despierta tras un accidente en la superficie marciana y debe gestionar oxígeno, energía, temperatura y materiales para sobrevivir, reparar un refugio y volver a casa. Una partida dura entre 15 y 25 minutos.
summary: Survive on Mars: Manage oxygen, energy and food. Explore 5 zones, beat bosses and finish 10 chapters with real NASA data. Learn while you play!
details:
MARS SURVIVAL

Wake up next to a crashed ship on Mars. Your oxygen is running out, the cold is draining your suit and a mysterious energy signal is calling from far away. Survive, explore and find out where it comes from.

Mars Survival is a free game for kids aged 7 to 12, and for families and classrooms. It teaches how astronauts really survive in deep space by making every decision cost something.

HOW DO YOU PLAY?

Guide your astronaut across a large Martian map and keep five meters alive: oxygen, energy, temperature, food and health. Mine metal and ice, craft tools, build solar panels and a greenhouse. Fight against creatures that come out at night. Complete 10 chapters, from repairing the radio and calling Earth to crossing a canyon, a volcano, the polar cap and dark caves, defeating 4 bosses, and launching from an ascent tower.

NOTHING IS FREE

- The heater keeps you warm, but it drains your battery.

- Sprinting saves time, but burns oxygen and energy.

- Solar panels charge much less at night and during dust storms.

- A solar flare gives you 10 seconds to run back to the habitat.

- Earth's reply on the radio arrives late, because signals take minutes to cross space.

REAL NASA SCIENCE

The game uses real data about Mars, shown as short science facts while you play: the thin carbon dioxide atmosphere, the cold, oxygen made from Martian air by the MOXIE experiment, radiation measured by the Curiosity rover. The 2018 dust storm that cut power to the Opportunity rover, hematite "blueberries", polar ice, possible caves, and the radio delay between Earth and Mars. The data is embedded, not live. A source screen inside the game lists every source and marks what is real and what is fiction.

PLAY IT AGAIN!

Every game creates a new world from a random seed. Choose between Easy, Normal or Hard level. Try different upgrades and routes, and when you fail you get a short tip and can retry the same world instantly.

EASY TO START

Spanish and English. Keyboard, mouse or touch controls. No ads, no accounts, nothing to install.

An educational project for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
